title: Regular monomial coefficients for a continuous Galois cocycle
statement: For a field K and a prescribed continuous homogeneous degree-two Galois units cocycle z [def-sc-galois-units-cohomology], there are a nonzero n, a permutation homomorphism p:G to Perm(Fin n), and unit coefficients w:G times Fin n to Ksep units. The map g to (p(g),w(g)) is locally constant, and w(g,p(h)j) g(w(h,j)) = c(g,h) w(gh,j), with c the prescribed evaluation [def-sc-brauer-scalar-defect].

source.place: Theorem 03R7 surjectivity and Section 0DVG; explicit regular coefficients and finite Galois descent expanded from the parent construction

proof.text: Obtain n, the transported finite quotient group, q,d, local constancy, factorization, and the twisted equation from [lem-sc-finite-galois-cocycle-data].

Construct the regular permutation homomorphism explicitly using MulAction.toPermHom with the quotient group structure and its own regular action, then compose with q. Define w(g,j)=d(q(g),j). The paired function (p,w) is a postcomposition of q, hence locally constant.

On each j, the regular action sends j to q(h)j for the transported group multiplication. Substitute this into the finite twisted equation, and substitute c(g,h)=d(q(g),q(h)). This proves the coefficient identity.
